root_cause.text: The stm32_ospi_remove callback incorrectly returns early when pm_runtime_resume_and_get() fails, causing the driver to skip necessary cleanup of the SPI controller and other resources.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff eliminates the 'if (ret < 0) return;' block that previously halted execution after pm_runtime_resume_and_get(), thereby guaranteeing that spi_unregister_controller(ospi->ctrl) and subsequent cleanup steps are always reached.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement represents the early return in stm32_ospi_remove when pm_runtime_resume_and_get() fails. According to the root cause, this early return skips necessary cleanup of the SPI controller and other resources (mutex_destroy, dma_release_channel, etc.) that should occur during driver removal. The error handling path shown in the snippet (err_pm_enable) contains the proper cleanup code, but the early return prevents reaching it.
